statement.p: Find a formula for the trigonometric function graphed below. Use x as the independent variable in your formula.

static.solution:
SOLUTION
This function resembles a sine curve in that the graph is at its midline when x = 0. Since the graph heads down and takes negative values as x increases from x=0 (instead of going up), we need to use the formula f(x) = - \sin{(x)}. We know that the smallest value it attains is 0, that its midline is y = 2, so its amplitude is 2 as well. Thus in the equation f(x) = -A \sin{(Bx)} + k we know that A = 2 and k = 2. Since the graph has a period of 16, the value for B = \frac{2 \pi}{\mbox{period}} = \frac{2 \pi}{16} = \frac{\pi}{8}. Finally we have a formula: f(x) = 2-2 \sin{ \left( \frac{\pi}{8} x \right) }.
